policy: English is allowed only when it is a technical contract or the explicit subject of an i18n story.

technicalExceptions.scope: Storybook titles, component names, props, variants and story identifiers
technicalExceptions.reason: These values identify the public developer contract and are not end-user interface copy.

technicalExceptions.scope: Package names, imports, URLs, email addresses, IDs and file formats
technicalExceptions.reason: Translation would alter executable or interoperable technical values.

technicalExceptions.scope: Brand names, product abbreviations and grid markers such as col-6
technicalExceptions.reason: These strings are proper names or documented layout contracts.

technicalExceptions.scope: Code examples inside docs source blocks
technicalExceptions.reason: Code samples may preserve API identifiers while the rendered user-facing example remains Russian.
